content.title: 状语从句综合复习·连词速查
content.intro: 状语从句用一个连词把“时间、条件、让步、原因、结果、目的、方式”等信息接到主句上。判断口诀:先看主句和从句之间是哪种逻辑关系,再选对应的连词;同一类里的连词意思相近,但不同类绝不能混用。

rows: when / while / as / until / before / after / as soon as
When you look up, you can see the murals.
if / unless / as long as / in case
If the weather is good, we will climb the sand mountain.
Although it sits in the desert, it is rich in culture.
Since the Silk Road passed through it, Dunhuang grew rich.
so + 形/副 + that;such + (a/an) + 名 + that
The cave was so dark that we could hardly see.
Come closer so that you can see the details.
The figures look as if they are floating.

specialRules.rule: so 接形容词/副词,such 接名词:so beautiful that… / such a city that…
specialRules.mark: so + adj + that / such + a + n + that

specialRules.rule: unless = if…not,本身已含否定,从句不再加 not
specialRules.mark: Unless you book a ticket, you can't enter.

specialRules.rule: in case = 以防(万一),后接“可能发生的情况”,不表“如果就一定”
specialRules.mark: Take water in case you feel thirsty.

specialRules.rule: although / though 不能与 but 连用;but 与 although 二选一
as if / as though 后既可用陈述语气,也可用虚拟(were)表与事实相反
specialRules.mark: looked as if it were a dream

why: 状语从句考的不是语法术语,而是“逻辑选词”:同样的两个分句,换一个连词意思就全变了。先想清楚是“因为、虽然、只要、以便、仿佛”中的哪一种,再下笔,答案自然唯一。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/完形高频:由句子逻辑判断 when/if/unless/although/because/so that 等连词。
so…that 与 such…that 辨析(看后面接形容词还是名词)。
易混:while 既可表“当…时”(时间),也可表“尽管/而”(让步对比);as 既表“随着/当…时”,也表“因为”,需看上下文。

examVsReal.exam: Although it is far, it is worth visiting.(考试要求完整连词)
examVsReal.real: It's far, but so worth visiting!
examVsReal.note: 口语里常用 but/though 放句末,书面考试更爱句首 although。

examVsReal.exam: I'll go early so that I can see the sunrise.(目的状语从句)
examVsReal.real: I'll go early to catch the sunrise.
examVsReal.note: 口语常用不定式 to do 表目的,更简洁;考试爱考 so that 从句。
